name: Wittenberge
datum: cm above gauge zero (16.707 m NHN, DHHN2016)
license: PEGELONLINE part: DL-DE->Zero-2.0 (WSV). hyd1d part: no data license stated by the BfG (see research/datasets/europe.md); clear before republishing.
notes: 1960-01-01 to 2026-08-10: BfG hyd1d daily mean W (station WITTENBERGE), file https://hyd1d.bafg.de/downloads/df.gauging_data_latest.RDS (Last-Modified Tue, 11 Aug 2026 04:43:04 GMT).

hyd1d values through 2025 are marked measured (validated by the WSV/BfG); values from 2026 are means of PEGELONLINE raw data, not validated, and marked provisional (df.gauging_data help page). hyd1d has no per-value flag.
Missing days inside the hyd1d span: 0; empty values dropped: 0.

After hyd1d: PEGELONLINE 15-minute raw W (WASSERSTAND ROHDATEN), daily mean over MEZ days (UTC+1), rounded to whole cm as hyd1d does, only days with at least 90 of 96 values; all marked provisional. 30 days from 2 saved pull(s): 503050_W_20261015T1115Z.json, 503050_W_20261015T1132Z.json.
Gap left unfilled between the end of hyd1d (2026-08-10) and the first PEGELONLINE day (2026-09-15): 35 days.

Gauge zero from PEGELONLINE station metadata: 16.707 m. ü. NHN (DHHN2016), valid from 2019-11-01. hyd1d levels are relative to the gauge zero in force at the time. The 2019-11-01 date, shared by most WSV gauges, marks the switch from DHHN92 to DHHN2016, not a physical change, and does not change W.
Coordinates and river km from PEGELONLINE station metadata (km 453.98, agency STANDORT MAGDEBURG).

measurement_history.fact: Start of readings, early reading method and gauge-zero history: not found. The hyd1d record used here starts 1960-01-01.
Neighbor comparison (hyd1d_stepscan.py) found no gauge-zero step.

public_notes: The level is measured against a fixed mark, not the riverbed, so it is not the water depth. Values from 2026 are unchecked raw readings, and August 11 to September 14, 2026 is missing.
